basics.label: Hydrology PhD Student
basics.summary: I am studying for a Ph.D. in Hydrology in the Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Management at the University of Hawaii at Manoa. My research focuses on soil moisture's role in the hydrological cycle, with the goal of improving drought prediction and ecosystem dynamics.

education.area: Natural Resources and Environmental Management (expected Spring, 2028)
